1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing and using the Thrive.Her website, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement.

2. About Thrive.Her

Thrive.Her is a registered charity dedicated to empowering women and girls through education, healthcare, and community support programs.

3. Use of Website

You may use our website for lawful purposes only. You agree not to use the site:

  • In any way that violates any applicable law or regulation

4. Donations

All donations made through our website are processed securely and are final. We provide receipts for all donations for tax purposes where applicable.

5. Volunteer Registration

Volunteer registration is subject to our vetting procedures and approval. We reserve the right to decline volunteer applications at our discretion.
